name: ritos-workspace
description: Runs RITOS API, RITOS desk portal and the ShopFlow demo store together

scripts.dev:plain: node scripts/dev/free-ports.mjs && concurrently --names API,DESK,SHOP,READY --prefix-colors blue.bold,magenta.bold,green.bold,yellow.bold --prefix "[{name}]" "node scripts/dev/run-api.mjs" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix shopflow run dev -- -p 3000" "node scripts/dev/ready.mjs"
